about: Planner ruling 23 live check: 40 short lines written fresh for this check (not from bench/), each labelled with the kind of quantity it mentions before any run. Labels: length | mass | time | temperature | volume | none. A line whose label needs a word of explanation carries a one-line reason; any line two readers could label differently was left out.

items.text: The shelf is 80 centimetres wide.
items.label: length

items.text: We walked six kilometres to the lake.
items.label: length

items.text: The cable needs another two metres.
items.label: length

items.text: Her hair grew an inch this month.
items.label: length

items.text: The runway is 3,000 feet long.
items.label: length

items.text: The marathon covers 42.195 km.
items.label: length

items.text: Cut the plank to half a yard.
items.label: length
items.reason: a yard here is the unit of length (cutting a plank), not a garden

items.text: The parcel weighs 3 kilograms.
items.label: mass

items.text: Add 250 grams of flour.
items.label: mass

items.text: The truck carries 12 tonnes of gravel.
items.label: mass

items.text: He lost five pounds of body weight over the winter.
items.label: mass
items.reason: pounds of body weight are a mass, not money

items.text: A single paperclip weighs about one gram.
items.label: mass

items.text: The baby weighed 7 lb 4 oz at birth.
items.label: mass

items.text: Each sack holds 50 kg of rice.
items.label: mass
items.reason: the amount is given in kilograms, a mass, although the verb is 'holds'

items.text: The meeting lasted forty minutes.
items.label: time

items.text: Boil the eggs for nine minutes.
items.label: time

items.text: The lease runs for three years.
items.label: time

items.text: The film is two and a half hours long.
items.label: time
items.reason: 'long' describes a duration in hours, not a length

items.text: Wait 30 seconds before you press again.
items.label: time

items.text: The warranty expires after 18 months.
items.label: time

items.text: She slept for eight hours.
items.label: time

items.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C.
items.label: temperature

items.text: Last night it dropped to minus twelve degrees Celsius.
items.label: temperature

items.text: Water boils at 212 °F at sea level.
items.label: temperature

items.text: The fridge should stay at 4 degrees Celsius.
items.label: temperature

items.text: The patient has a fever of 39.5 °C.
items.label: temperature

items.text: Liquid nitrogen boils at 77 kelvin.
items.label: temperature
items.reason: the kelvin is a unit of temperature

items.text: Set the thermostat to 68 degrees Fahrenheit.
items.label: temperature

items.text: Pour 500 millilitres of stock into the pot.
items.label: volume

items.text: The tank holds 60 litres.
items.label: volume

items.text: Drink two cups of water with each meal.
items.label: volume
items.reason: a cup of water is a kitchen measure of volume

items.text: The pool contains 50 cubic metres of water.
items.label: volume
items.reason: cubic metres measure volume, not length

items.text: Add a tablespoon of olive oil.
items.label: volume
items.reason: a tablespoon is a kitchen measure of volume

items.text: He bought a gallon of milk.
items.label: volume

items.text: The committee approved the plan.
items.label: none

items.text: She has three brothers.
items.label: none
items.reason: a count of people is not one of the five kinds of quantity

items.text: Room 404 is on the fourth floor.
items.label: none
items.reason: the numbers are names of a room and a floor, not measured quantities

items.text: The vote was 7 to 2.
items.label: none
items.reason: a vote count is not one of the five kinds of quantity

items.text: Call me back when you can.
items.label: none

items.text: The shirt costs 20 dollars.
items.label: none
items.reason: money is not one of the five kinds of quantity
